verdict.rationale: Next.js is an open-source React framework that developers run on their own infrastructure. It is not a service that holds user data, so an opt-out from AI model training is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Next.js collecting or training on user data. The built-in MCP endpoint only gives coding agents access to a developer's own running app, which is a different axis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
